en.title: Bring your week
en.body: After the demo, bring your clients, your rhythms and your team, and we put your own week into the platform with you. You see your week run in it, and it leads into the paid pilot. We reply within one working day.

da.title: Kom med jeres uge
da.body: Efter demoen kommer I med jeres kunder, jeres rytmer og jeres hold, så lægger vi jeres egen uge ind i platformen sammen med jer. I ser jeres uge køre i den, og det fører videre til den betalte pilot. Vi svarer inden for 1 arbejdsdag.
